text:
Ashwin: kicking off background migration for customer_profiles -> add `last_seen_ts` (bigint) + partial TTL index on active customers. Window: 30m maintenance lull. starting @deploybot. pls ack and monitor.

deploybot: queued mig job id=mig-3112223344-bg on dbpool-4. running in chunked mode (chunk_size=5k). auto-pause if any chunk lock_wait >10s or replica_lag >45s for >60s. logs: https://deploy/logs/mig-3112223344

Maria: heads-up: nightly analytics bulk export at :40, we pushed it earlier. i'll watch planner and grep for seq scans.

Jordan: i'm throttling internal report writer to 0.2 qps. also draining read replica rr-eu-west-1 for 12m. ran `/drain-rr rr-eu-west-1 --table=customer_profiles --timeout=12m`

Sam: drafting release note: "Add last_seen_ts and TTL enforcement for inactive rows; migration performed in maintenance window; no client-facing schema change for reads." pinning to release v2.1.1-beta.

SRE-Oncall: define pause vs rollback and quick rollback commands. need alerts for p50/p95 write latency, replica lag, and error_rate.

Ashwin: Pause conditions: any chunk lock_wait >10s OR replica_lag >45s sustained >60s OR p95 write latency >350ms for 3m. On pause deploybot will post holdpin and leave migration paused for manual review. Rollback triggers: migration job fails 2x OR write error_rate >30% above baseline for 5m OR customer errors spike >2% for 3m. Quick rollback steps:
```
# stop migrator
systemctl stop migrator || true
# terminate active alter queries
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ~ 'ALTER TABLE customer_profiles' AND state <> 'idle';
# revert schema
ALTER TABLE customer_profiles DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS last_seen_ts;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_cp_last_seen_ttl_partial;
```
Full runbook at /runbooks/migrations/customer_profiles.md.

deploybot: ack. current progress: processed_rows=23,400; throughput ~140 rows/s; no pause conditions hit. posting perf snapshot to infra metrics.

Maria: ran EXPLAIN on chunk 3 — index-only scan on pk, planner looks stable. will run EXPLAIN ANALYZE if we see latency blips.

Jordan: drain complete, replica lag ~6s. i'll keep tailing.

Ashwin: thanks. checkpoint update at 50k rows or sooner if holdpin posted.
